title: SS27 Men's Colour Stories
summary: Three colour stories for SS27 menswear: Sun-Faded for tailoring and linen, Aquatic for summer shirts and shorts, and Orange Energy for statements.

sections.heading: Sun-Faded
sections.body: Optic white, sand, tobacco and ice blue<sup>[1]</sup>. Tailoring, shirting, linen. Brunello Cucinelli's cable knits with a sun-faded finish, achieved with resin in the dyeing process, show the look in knitwear<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Aquatic
sections.body: Turquoise, sky blue and electric blue on leather jackets, shorts, linen shirts, socks and boat shoes<sup>[3]</sup>. Pair with white.

sections.heading: Orange Energy
sections.body: Blood orange, rust, tangerine and true orange, on a sunset-gradient overcoat, a cropped blouson or a V-neck sweater, or as a single accessory such as a bag or cap<sup>[3]</sup>.

design_implications:
- Give each story its own delivery or capsule.
- Sun-Faded mixes with both other stories; Aquatic and Orange are best kept apart.
commercial_implications: - Sun-Faded carries volume; Aquatic and Orange Energy carry newness.
